name: Airway Medix S.A.
summary: Airway Medix S.A. specializes in the research, development, and market introduction of disposable medical devices. These products are specifically designed for patients on mechanical ventilation in intensive care units and for individuals in critical, life-threatening conditions within anesthesiology departments. Their portfolio includes a Closed Suction System for clearing endotracheal tubes in mechanically ventilated patients, an Oral Care system to maintain oral hygiene for intubated and immobilized individuals, and a Cuff Pressure Regulator for continuous monitoring and consistent pressure management of intubation tube cuffs. The company is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.
